_comment: T17 hardcoded expectations for fetch platform=ios appVersion=2.1.0. Variant arm asserted as membership in {control,treatment} + value-consistency + stickiness (see e2e.sh), never derived dynamically. Stats are env-wide (?since=-only, no flag attribution): counts unchanged by the flag-column drop because every T17 event already belonged to one env, so same-day rows merge into identical buckets under the (day,env,variant,version) rollup key.

stage3b_purge._comment: 3 backdated (~35d) rows: 2 fetches (variant '') + 1 exposure (control). Live purge rolls them into event_daily then deletes raw. Counts unchanged without flag splitting: all rows share one env so the (day,env,variant,version) key yields the same buckets.
